method_limits: This reconciles existing evidence; it is not a new pixel reading or another independent historical observation.
Reproducible annotation arithmetic cannot establish original-curve containment or model fidelity.
Single-fragment geometric eligibility is not a calibrated source bound; F3's existing screen is not repeated or generalized automatically.
No arbitrary common pixel radius, averaging, gap/seam bridging, hidden-curve duplication or zero-support substitution is adopted.
Conditional graphical estimates are not prohibited merely because exact pre-raster arrays or identical JPEG encoding are unavailable.
Inventory candidates outside finished targets remain recoverable work or source-specific unresolved dispositions, not wholesale exclusions introduced for convenience.
